description: Quote how hard a Solana vanity address is and what to escrow for it. Give a Base58 prefix and/or suffix and get the expected attempts, rarity tier, and an honest suggested USDC bounty (atomic units) from the difficulty→price oracle. Pure function of the pattern — no wallet, no payment, fully read-only. Use this before posting a grind-bounty so you escrow a fair amount.

ignoreCase.description: Match the pattern case-insensitively (cheaper, less rare). Default false.

prefix.description: Base58 prefix the address must start with (e.g. "THREE").

suffix.description: Base58 suffix the address must end with.

name: vanity_quote
title: Quote the bounty price for a vanity pattern
